linkedPullRequests.title: Fix the bgpmon flakyness
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
Why I did:
Fixes Issue https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/2969

Root cause:
API verify_packet_any_port() return port index and not port https://github.com/p4lang/ptf/blob/c221d0c6e230f51884444ff78bba2c5755534ae6/src/ptf/testutils.py#L2681
On the setup where I tested earlier as part of https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/2943 port and port-index were same so missed it catching it.
Log https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/build/_test/analytics?definitionId=1&contextType=build pointed out this mismatch.
